description: Move `metrics` (incl. `feedback` + `waitlist`) handlers/services into `scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/domain/metrics/` with grouped `Deps` struct + exported `RegisterRoutes(router, deps)`. Update `routes.go` to call `metrics.RegisterRoutes` instead of `registerMetricsRoutes`/`registerFeedbackRoutes`/`registerWaitlistRoutes`. Remove the moved fields from the `Server` struct in `main.go`. Move the per-domain test files alongside their source and adjust to use exported APIs. Behavior-preserving: every URL path, HTTP method, middleware chain, status code, and response body shape unchanged. Recommended first because it touches the fewest shared helpers (per the dep-graph research). Acceptance: `vrooli scenario test landing-page-business-suite` passes; `go list ./...` shows the new `api/domain/metrics` package; old `register{Metrics,Feedback,Waitlist}Routes` removed; no import cycles.
name: lpbs-api-extract-metrics-domain
title: Extract LPBS metrics domain into api/domain/metrics/
